plainText:
The King's Identity...!! (Japanese: 「王」の正体は…!! The King's Identity...!!) is the second chapter of the Pocket Monsters BW: The Heroes of Fire and Thunder manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Traveling with Shin, N shares his dream with him—to make a world where Pokémon live happily.
Reaching Dragonspiral Tower, Togari splits up Shin and N to battles Shin to give his "King" enough time to befriend the Legendary Pokémon atop it.
N becomes the Hero of Thunder and reveals his position—"King" of Team Plasma.
